Petit Versus 1. The State of Bihar through the Chief Secretary, Government of Bihar, Pa 2. The Secretary, Ministry of Food and Consumer Protection Department, Government of Bihar, Patna. 3. The Commissioner of Food Safety, Government of Bihar, Patna. 4. The Managing Director, Bihar State Food and Civil Supplies Corporation, Patna. 5. The District Magistrate, District-Samastipur. 6. The Additional Collector cum Additional District Magistrate, District- Samastipur. 7. The District Supply Officer, District-Samastipur. 8. The District Cooperative Officer, District-Samastipur. 9. The District Panchayati Raj Officer cum Nodal Officer, Paddy Procuremen District-Samastipur. 10. The Deputy Collector Land Reforms, District-Samastipur. 11. The District Manager, Bihar State Food and Civil Supplies Corporation, District-Samastipur. 12. The Factory Inspector, District-Samastipur. ... ... Respondent/s ====================================================== Appearance : For the Petitioner : Mr. Niraj Lochan Jha, Advocate Mr. Adarsh Naman, Advocate For the State : Mr. P.K. Shahi, Advocate General Mr. Vikas Kumar, Ac to Ag For the Bsfc : Mr. Anjani Kumar, Senior Advocate Mr. Shailendra Kumar Singh, Advocate =====================================================
